第85章 用事实说话-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

接下来几天，王建新算是带队正式进驻医务室。医疗队和医务室之间的合作，比想象中更加微妙。

张文华表面上配合，但暗地里处处掣肘。药柜的钥匙他攥着不撒手，刘晓东去取药，他就站在旁边，嘴里念叨着“这个不能动”“那个有数的”。陈秀英要清点纱布和绷带的数量，他说“昨天刚盘过，不用点了”。周小梅要给一个烫伤的工人换药，他就站在旁边盯着，两手插在白大褂的口袋里，一言不发，但那表情分明写着“我倒要看看你们有多大本事”。

最让医疗队上火的是张文华在工人和医务室工作人员面前说的话。

“这些大学生啊，理论一套一套的，实操不行。骨折复位，那不是一天两天就能学会的。我干了二十多年也没学会。”他说话的时候声音不大，但诊室里的人都听得见。几个医务室的工作人员低着头，不敢吭声，但耳朵竖得老高。

刘晓东听到后，脸都气绿了。他跑到王建新跟前，压低声音说：“队长，你听听他说的是人话吗？”王建新正在整理医疗包，头都没抬，淡淡地说了一句：“用事实说话。”

刘晓东张了张嘴，把到嘴边的话咽了回去。

六月五号，机会来了。

那天上午，医务室来了一位特殊病人。老孙头，炼钢车间炉前工，五十二岁，是厂里的老先进。他的左膝疼了七八年，蹲不下，蹲下就起不来。厂里医务室给他开了止疼片，吃了就不疼，停了就疼。他以为这辈子就这样了，听说医务室新来了一支北医医疗队。

老孙头拄着拐杖挪进来，一步一步的，走得很费劲。他的脸上被炉火熏得黝黑，皱纹像刀刻的一样，但眼睛很亮，亮得像炉膛里的钢水。他扶着诊桌，慢慢坐下来，把那根自制的木拐杖靠在桌边。

“同志，”他的声音沙哑，带着浓重的河北口音，“我这条腿疼了七八年了，能不能治？”

王建新让他坐到检查床上，把裤腿卷上去。左膝比右膝粗了一圈，皮肤发暗，按下去硬邦邦的。他用神识探查——左膝内侧半月板陈旧性撕裂，关节软骨严重磨损，软骨下骨裸露，关节腔里有大量炎性渗出液，骨质边缘增生明显。典型的重度膝关节骨性关节炎合并半月板损伤，这不是光靠止疼片就能解决的问题。

“能治。”王建新说。

老孙头眼睛一亮：“真的？”

“真的。”王建新从医疗包里取出针灸针，“针灸配合中药，先缓解疼痛，再治根。你这条腿少说还能用二十年。”

老孙头的眼眶红了，嘴唇哆嗦了几下，没说出话来。

王建新在老孙头的左膝取穴——内外膝眼、血海、梁丘、阳陵泉、足三里。银针刺入，施以温针灸，灵力随着银针渗入关节腔，驱散盘踞在软骨表面的风寒湿邪。那邪气已由表入里，深入骨空，寻常针灸只能止痛，不能治根。王建新将灵力凝聚成一丝细线，沿着骨空探入，将深藏在骨髓里的寒湿之气一丝一丝地抽出来。

老孙头只觉得一股温热的气流从膝盖往大腿根窜，又暖又舒服，紧锁的眉头慢慢舒展开了，舒服得直哼哼。

施针半小时，王建新拔了针，让老孙头每天来针灸一次，一个星期后就能看到效果。然后又开了一张方子，让刘晓东去药房抓药。张文华这次没拦着，站在药房门口，看着刘晓东抓药，嘴唇动了动，没说话。

In the next few days, Wang Jianxin led the team to officially enter the medical office.The cooperation between the medical team and the infirmary is more subtle than imagined.

Zhang Wenhua cooperates on the surface, but secretly he is hampered by everything.He clutched the key to the medicine cabinet and wouldn't let go. When Liu Xiaodong went to get the medicine, he stood beside him, muttering "Don't touch this one" and "That one is numbered."Chen Xiuying wanted to count the number of gauze and bandages. He said, "I just took stock of them yesterday, so there is no need to order them."When Zhou Xiaomei was about to change the dressing for a burnt worker, he stood nearby and stared, his hands in the pockets of his white coat, without saying a word, but his expression clearly said "I want to see how capable you are."

What angered the medical team the most was what Zhang Wenhua said in front of the workers and medical office staff.

"These college students have a lot of theory, but they can't do it in practice. Fracture reduction can't be learned in a day or two. I haven't learned it after working for more than 20 years." When he spoke, his voice was not loud, but everyone in the clinic could hear it.Several staff in the infirmary lowered their heads and did not dare to say a word, but their ears were perked up.

When Liu Xiaodong heard this, his face turned green with anger.He ran to Wang Jianxin and lowered his voice and said: "Captain, do you hear what he said is human language?" Wang Jianxin was packing the medical bag, and without even raising his head, he said lightly: "Speak with the facts."

Liu Xiaodong opened his mouth and swallowed the words that came to his lips.

On June 5th, the opportunity came.

That morning, a special patient came to the infirmary.Lao Suntou, a furnace worker in the steelmaking workshop, is fifty-two years old and is a veteran in the factory.His left knee had been hurting for seven or eight years, and he couldn't squat or get up from squatting.The factory infirmary prescribed painkillers for him. The pain stopped when he took it, but hurt when he stopped.He thought this would be it for the rest of his life, but he heard that a new medical team from Beijing Medical University had arrived in the infirmary.

Old Sun moved in with a cane, step by step, walking very hard.His face was darkened by the fire, and his wrinkles were like those carved by a knife, but his eyes were bright, as bright as molten steel in the furnace.He held the examination table, slowly sat down, and leaned the homemade wooden crutch against the edge of the table.

"Comrade," his voice was hoarse with a strong Hebei accent, "I've been having pain in my leg for seven or eight years. Can it be cured?"

Wang Jianxin asked him to sit on the examination bed and roll up his trouser legs.The left knee is thicker than the right knee, the skin is dark, and it feels stiff when pressed.He used his spiritual consciousness to detect - there was an old tear in the medial meniscus of the left knee, the articular cartilage was severely worn, the subchondral bone was exposed, there was a large amount of inflammatory exudate in the joint cavity, and the bone edge hyperplasia was obvious.Typical severe knee osteoarthritis combined with meniscus damage is a problem that cannot be solved by painkillers alone.

"It can be cured." Wang Jianxin said.

Lao Suntou's eyes lit up: "Really?"

"Really." Wang Jianxin took out an acupuncture needle from the medical bag, "Acupuncture combined with traditional Chinese medicine can first relieve the pain and then cure the root cause. Your leg can be used for at least twenty years."

Lao Suntou's eyes were red, his lips trembled a few times, but he didn't say anything.

Wang Jianxin selected acupoints on the left knee of Lao Suntou - the inner and outer knee eyes, Xuehai, Liangqiu, Yanglingquan and Zusanli.The silver needle is inserted and warm acupuncture is applied. The spiritual power penetrates into the joint cavity along with the silver needle, dispelling the wind, cold and damp evil entrenched on the cartilage surface.The evil energy has entered from the outside and penetrated deeply into the bone. Ordinary acupuncture can only relieve pain but cannot cure the root cause.Wang Jianxin condensed his spiritual power into a thin thread, probed along the bone void, and pulled out the cold and damp air hidden deep in the bone marrow one by one.

Lao Suntou felt a stream of warm air running from his knees to his thighs. It was warm and comfortable. His frown slowly relaxed, and he hummed in comfort.

After applying the acupuncture for half an hour, Wang Jianxin pulled out the acupuncture and asked Lao Suntou to come for acupuncture once a day. The effect will be seen in a week.Then he wrote another prescription and asked Liu Xiaodong to go to the pharmacy to get the medicine.Zhang Wenhua did not stop him this time. He stood at the door of the pharmacy and watched Liu Xiaodong take the medicine. His lips moved but he said nothing.
